sources_read: .qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r2/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (Quality Checks sheet row 18 = check #17 solution_covers_every_deliverable; Internal Quality Checks row 18, identical wording; no cell comments on the row)
evidence: Walked instruction.md and all three /instructions notes line by line against the frozen reference; every asked-for screen, role and flow has an implementation. Sign-in gate: index.html:10-21 sign-in card, #app hidden until /api/me succeeds (app.js:60-70); every /api route calls requireUser (server.js:182-186); transcripts answer 'Please sign in' (server.js:493). Accounts/roles: seeded from seed.accounts with password123 (server.js:96-100); clients see only their matters, staff all but walled (server.js:189-193). Walls by every route: matter list, thread, search, mentions, unread, previews, quotes, transcript and direct message all go through visibleMatter/visibleMessage and answer 'Not available.' (server.js:194-201, 226-235, 320-384, 488-496). Partner add/lift wall UI (index.html:66-73, app.js:247-278, 484-490; server.js:470-481); live removal for an open matter via 2 s poll -> 404 -> showUnavailable (app.js:557-568, 197-210). Timers: off/1/7/30 select for partners (index.html:55-65), partner-only server check, immediate sweep on shorten, never restore (server.js:458-468, 139-154); 'exactly seven days' handled by >= (server.js:143); label beside title (index.html:49-50, server.js:246). Holds: partner place/release on any message incl. replies (app.js:342, server.js:448-456), exact-message scope, sweep on release, held never deleted (server.js:142, 443), 'On hold' badge separate from body text (app.js:309). Replies: unlimited-depth tree in seq order under the parent (server.js:253-279), parent quote or deleted-quote text (server.js:287, app.js:303-308); deleted-with-replies placeholder identical for author delete and timer (both use eraseMessage; app.js:300). Edits: author-only edit/delete, 'edited' label, versions for staff (server.js:361-369, 418-446; app.js:338-341); stale edit refused 409 with typed text kept (server.js:426-428; app.js:411-414 does not reset the composer). Formatting: escape-first renderer for *bold*, `code`, '> ' quotes and http(s) links with target=_blank (app.js:22-54); textContent/esc for quotes, snippets, versions, previews and transcript (app.js:307, 466, 549; server.js:485-506). Message links: Copy link (app.js:443-451); per-reader server previews with 'not available' for walled or deleted targets (server.js:224-235, app.js:311-327). Mentions: @Name/@First parsed, recorded only for people who can see the matter, Mentions view and count (server.js:209-222, 320-324; app.js:511-521). Unread: per-user server-side read position, new-messages line, mark read on open, mark unread from any message, deleted excluded (server.js:239-245, 339-353; app.js:185-195, 434-442). Sending: client_key idempotency (server.js:396-415); one seq order used by thread, search and transcript. Live updates: 2 s polling preserving composer, scroll and open versions (app.js:224-238, 557-568). Search: case-insensitive, current text only, result opens the thread at the message (server.js:375-384; app.js:501-509, 543-553). Transcript page: matter number, title, generated time, threads oldest first, author/time/edited/hold, held-edited versions, placeholders, no chat controls, access-checked (server.js:488-509). Runtime contract: DB_PATH or app.db beside server.js, files relative to __dirname, 0.0.0.0:3000, health 200 registered before the DB check, one-time import, fixed clock (server.js:13-47, 93-128, 156-165). Phone: @media (max-width:720px) single-column layout, border-box sizing, wrapping topbar (styles.css:17, 39-40, 114-123). Runtime corroboration: raw-evidence-index artifact hashes re-verified; its matching_source_files hashes equal the frozen solution bytes; qc/repairs/kittle-2026-10-08/results/golden-run.log shows gate_constraints, all 16 functional checks and polish_refusal_in_place PASS across a real restart (scripted Playwright only; not a configured judge run, Oracle or model score). Notes, not defects: (1) the transcript prints allowed formatting markers literally (esc only, server.js:506); the brief requires only that markup shows as typed there. (2) solve.sh puts the seed copy at /app/seed/seed_data.json rather than /app/seed_data.json; it is still inside /app, and server.js:29 also accepts /app/seed_data.json. (3) A partner cannot wall herself (server.js:477), a reasonable reading of 'any of our staff'. (4) Search and Mentions views are not live-refreshed after a new wall; the brief scopes live removal to someone who has the matter open. (5) The 390 px phone layout and render/visual aspects are source-plausible only; the scripted golden run did not cover them (measured coverage belongs to row 18 and the visual rows). Adversarial: I looked for a brief capability the reference lacks (a broken-reference scenario) and found none; a conforming alternative app is not relevant to this reference-coverage row.
